arg.name: only_first_rosbag
arg.description: If true, replay only the first rosbag in the dataset. If false, replay everything.

arg.name: rosbag_dir
arg.description: Path to the directory containing the rosbags.

arg.name: odom_rosbag
arg.description: Path to the rosbag containing odometry, to resolve the LiDAR poses and undistort the pointclouds.

arg.name: first_rosbag
arg.description: Path to the first rosbag of the dataset. If only_first_rosbag:=true, only this bag will be processed.
